steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen.
Enable eRFX functionality required by the test company.
Ensure vendors can be added during event creation and publishing is not disabled.
Set the event type to RFQ as required by the scenario.
Provide the mandatory event title using an automatically generated unique title.
Apply the first available RFQ template so the pricing sheet can be populated.
Add the specified product and set its requested quantity to 10; the product's Variant 1 is expected to populate automatically.
Choose the required delivery location in the first line item.
Confirm the requested quantity was retained.
Confirm the selected delivery location is shown in the sheet.
Add the vendor named in the scenario before scheduling and publishing.
Open the Schedule Event drawer from the footer.
Verify that the configured 60 Mins duration is offered.
Choose the required 60-minute duration while keeping the default Start now setting.
Confirm the schedule drawer calculates and displays an end time for the selected duration.
Commit the start-now and 60-minute schedule.
Confirm the footer schedule summary shows the selected duration.
Publish the configured RFQ event and confirm the publish dialog.
Confirm publishing reached a real project page.
Verify the published Project Details page exposes the bidding end-time field.
